title: a red whose cast a door refuses raises a trouble naming the lacks
intention: A door refusing a red's ticket is a defect against outline 9.4.2.3.7.5, never an exception to it, and today it leaves no trace: on akiendell the lacks went to an uncaptured console and the red was ticketed by nobody. So when the sorted or cast door refuses a red's ticket (RedTicketRefused other than StoreUnreachable), run_proof still raises out loud as now AND raises the unticketed trouble naming the door and every lack, so a human sees both the red and why its ticket was refused. Every run still tries to write the red's ticket, as outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 requires; a refusal leaves the red new, so the next run tries again, and the trouble clears when one writes it or the proof reads green.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendell (Windows): the batch seal at 14:16-14:17 sealed test_ground_loop, test_stop_is_prompt and test_the_beat_calls_nothing red, and the tester's red cast wrote three sorted berths (~/.cairn/devices/skill_block/0/berths/sorted/ on akiendell: sorted-20261123T141629-9a1413e28611.json, sorted-20261123T141711-6e0d8ddd0889.json, sorted-20261123T141726-0e5707e0564e.json) and no ticket file. Nothing else on disk names why: no tester trouble, no notice, no refusal trace in 14:10-14:30; the seal's console was not captured. red_tickets._cast fires the sorted door BEFORE cast_ticket, so a berth with no ticket is exactly what a CastRefused leaves, and device.py run_proof catches only StoreUnreachable: every other RedTicketRefused goes to stderr alone and its lacks are lost. The same cast over a scratch commons on akiendell casts cleanly, so the refusal was live-store-specific and is now unrecoverable. The three reds were recast on the Dell as 05912c132e46, 0bd592ceba49, d61908745347.
traces_to: Law 7 (errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth: a door's refusal of a red's ticket was loud only on an uncaptured console); outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost)
how: In cairn/devices/tester/device.py run_proof, the except clause around red_tickets.ticket_what_is_new catches RedTicketRefused as well as StoreUnreachable. For a refusal it raises the unticketed trouble (the same identity _raise_unticketed uses) with detail naming the door and the lacks, emits red_unticketed, then re-raises so the run still exits non-zero. A red-first proof drives run_proof's ticketing over a scratch commons whose cast door refuses, and reads the trouble from the scratch trouble store.

clauses.claim: a red whose cast the cast door refuses (a scratch store whose cast_ticket raises CastRefused) leaves a live unticketed trouble for that proof whose detail names the door 'cast' and the lacks the door named
the same refusal still raises out of run_proof (the run fails loud, not silently on)
a red whose store is unreachable still raises its unticketed trouble and goes on, as before

the red stays new after a refusal: the next run over the same red tries its ticket again, and once the door admits it the ticket is written and the trouble clears (outline 9.4.2.3.7.5: the run writes the ticket)

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/device.py run_proof catches red_tickets.RedTicketRefused after its StoreUnreachable clause; it calls _raise_unticketed with the refusal (its why names 'the {door} door refused the ticket' and its detail carries door and lacks), emits red_unticketed with the same reason, and re-raises. _raise_unticketed takes the exception and words the why by its kind; its StoreUnreachable wording is unchanged.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_red_whose_cast_a_door_refuses_raises_a_trouble.py, PROVES 150133a3ca74 keys 1-4, one tooth per clause, over the scratch fixture shape of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_red_that_cannot_be_ticketed_raises_a_trouble.py, with the cast door made to refuse by monkeypatching red_tickets' cast_ticket to raise CastRefused.

constraints: the run still fails loud on a door's refusal: the trouble is added, the raise is not removed
StoreUnreachable keeps its present behaviour (trouble, then the run goes on)

the trouble never stands in for the ticket outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 requires: it is the record that the outline was not met, the red still needs its ticket, and the trouble clears only when a later run tickets the red or the proof reads green (_clear_unticketed in cairn/devices/tester/device.py)

the trouble passes outline 3.4.3.5's test: a door that refuses a red's ticket is fixed only by CC or Akien (the door or the red's packet changes), and no later run heals it on its own; it clears when that fix lets a run ticket the red, or the proof reads green

this ticket adds no exception to outline 9.4.2.3.7.5: the door already refuses today with nothing on disk (measured 2026-11-23); the trouble is how the unmet requirement reaches someone who can meet it

out: cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py (the sorted-berth-before-cast order stays: the berth is the record of the sorted firing, and a refusal now names it)
why akiendell's live cast door refused at 14:16: the lacks are unrecoverable; the next refusal is what this records
